address: Asmalı Mescit Mahallesi, Meşrutiyet Caddesi No:107/F, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34430, Türkiye
bio: Once you enter the premises, leaving the bustling Pera district behind, you have a choice between a trendy bistro and a more romantic dining space with a vaulted ceiling. In either case, you'll be charmed by the mystical ambiance and the staff's enthusiasm and dedication – and that's before you've even discovered the restaurant's modern take on mezze! Traditional Turkish specialities, such as grilled lamb heart with roast potatoes, share the menu with in-vogue options, including vegetarian dishes – think sun-dried vegetables with tahini sauce. The tasting menu offers a wonderful opportunity to savour delicacies such as a slice of chestnut and caramel tart.
